01 / ABOUT ME

Structure, meaning,
and what comes next.

My research sits at the intersection of graph learning, semantic representations, and spatiotemporal data.

I started my PhD in October 2026 with the STORIES team at LIG in Grenoble, continuing the work I began during my master’s research internship on graph neural networks for spatiotemporal knowledge graphs.

I graduated with a master’s degree in Computer Engineering from Politecnico di Torino in July 2026, with a final grade of 107/110. My studies also took me to INP Grenoble for an M2 exchange, where I explored generative multimodal AI, GPU computing, and computer vision.

I’m particularly interested in bringing semantic structure and deep learning together: building representations that connect the relationships in our data with the ways they change over time.

  2. 2024 — 2026FROM STUDY TO RESEARCH

    Master’s in Computer Engineering

    Politecnico di Torino · M2 exchange at INP Grenoble

    Graduated in July 2026 with a final grade of 107/110. During my 2026 internship with the STORIES team at LIG, I studied graph neural networks for spatiotemporal knowledge graphs representing semantic trajectories.

    My work included ontology-guided graph snapshots from RDF data, self-supervised representation learning, clustering, and entity alignment analysis.
